rv.q: The effect, in Matthew Lenton's high-precision production, is to turn a stressful night on the wards into something like gothic horror.
One of the most interesting sequences arrives when Matthew Lenton directs the silence around the climactic conversation between Flora and her patient (a captivating Aisha Goodman).
An odd emotional lacuna in the script by Josephine Eusebius ultimately limits the drama’s impact, however.

cn.t: Critics find this intense bilingual drama effectively captures the high-pressure horror of an understaffed hospital shift, with atmospheric staging elevating the nurse's life-and-death choices to gothic heights.
